doc.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Closing thoughts on gratitude and attitude
summary: Rowe thanks him; Morell says he is flattered; both agree friendship matters.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you know how to drive a big band, I can say that, because I’ve been rehearsing with this group tonight you know, and now I can put on my resume that I played with you.
Do you have anything else that you’d like to add before we sign off.

It’s nice to be asked about my past and my history. I’m flattered every time somebody is interested. And I enjoy revisiting the days. And if somebody could learn something or get something out of it, that’s great.
Well I like what you said about attitude and bringing professionalism as well as friendship to the gig, because it just adds to the good karma.
And sometimes it yields something down the road and sometimes it doesn’t.
Right. Well it doesn’t matter, you made a friend and that’s more important.
